components.name: Dialog / AlertDialog

components.name: Status / Result / AsyncProgress
components.behavior: Distinct denied/stale/partial/unknown/accepted/completed states; no generic success coercion.

components.name: ProtectedMediaView

components.name: SourceActionForm

components.name: AppShell / Navigation / Breadcrumbs
components.behavior: Role/current owner context drives available links; hidden navigation is not server access control.
